description: Show loading indicators for any operation longer than 200ms
rationale: Users perceive unresponsive UIs as broken without feedback

description: Design empty states with guidance, not a blank screen
rationale: Empty states are a first-impression teaching moment

description: Offer a clear retry or recovery action on every error state
rationale: Dead-end errors force users to reload or abandon the task

description: Apply optimistic UI updates where safe, with rollback on failure
rationale: Optimistic UI makes apps feel instantaneous

description: Validate fields on blur and show inline errors, not only on submit
rationale: Late feedback forces users to retrace their steps

description: Offer undo for delete and archive actions instead of confirm dialogs
rationale: Undo is faster and less cognitively demanding than confirmation

description: Show determinate progress for long tasks when possible
rationale: Progress bars make waits feel shorter and set expectations

description: Minimum touch target of 44x44 px per Apple HIG
rationale: Smaller targets cause mistaps on touchscreens

description: Keep primary navigation consistent across pages
rationale: Shifting navigation disorients users and breaks muscle memory

description: Autofocus the primary input when a form or modal opens
rationale: Autofocus saves a click and signals intent

description: Never break browser back/forward — sync URL with app state
rationale: Back button is the most-used navigation control on the web

description: Keep prose line length between 45 and 75 characters
rationale: Over-wide lines reduce reading speed and comprehension

description: One primary action per view; secondary actions visually subordinate
rationale: Multiple primary CTAs paralyze decision making
